name: Linear Edge Intersection for Dual Contouring
definition: Computes edge-surface intersections for dual contouring by finding where grid edges cross the iso-surface and computing intersection points using linear interpolation.
summary: Linear Edge Intersection for Dual Contouring places vertices by averaging edge intersection points, optionally refining with gradients, distinguishing itself from QEF solvers by prioritizing simplicity over geometric fidelity.
